description: In-game mod author, gameplay proof (red 20 of 21 from 2026-11-14 until the weapon got its view position, name and ammo, B-1149 to B-1151; since 2026-11-16 on shared base 7 the weapon is named, held and fires): one ordinary client launch creates a weapon mod from the extracted base Falcon 2 through --mod-author (the save, rescan, enable and apply path the in-game creators use), then starts an offline Combat Simulator match with that weapon as the spawn weapon, holds it in first person and fires it twice. No mod exists before the launch. The recipe has no overrides, so the held model, the animations, the sounds and both fire functions all come from the mod-owned archive the launch just wrote. Screenshots give a visual check that the weapon is drawn in the player's hand.

input_sequence.comment: Pause the script until the ordinary Combat Simulator player is continuously spawned, live, controllable and walking. The recipe has already run as the first CLI fast path, before the room launch flags.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Aim toward ordinary nearby world collision.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Fire the created weapon through the production fire path.
Exit after a stable held render, two fire edges and the captures.

required_lines: MODAUTHOR\.CATALOG\.OK catalog=mod:weapon_smoke_falcon type=\d+ enabled=1 bundled=0 category='mod\.weapon_smoke_falcon'
SETUP: MP weapon models preloaded from match config \(spawnWeapon=\d+ random=0\)
SPAWN: player 0 spawned with weapon \d+ \(Smoke Falcon\) -- auto-equipped to right hand
forbidden_patterns: BONDGUN\.SOURCE: catalog model source load failed
